name: rest-otm
description: Multi-Tenant Restaurant SaaS Platform — POS & ERP

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n API,ADMIN,WAITER,MENU,SUPER -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter @rest-otm/api dev" "pnpm --filter @rest-otm/admin dev" "pnpm --filter @rest-otm/waiter dev" "pnpm --filter @rest-otm/menu dev" "pnpm --filter @rest-otm/superadmin dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @rest-otm/receipt-core build && pnpm --filter @rest-otm/api build && pnpm --filter @rest-otm/print-agent build && pnpm --filter @rest-otm/admin build && pnpm --filter @rest-otm/waiter build && pnpm --filter @rest-otm/menu build && pnpm --filter @rest-otm/superadmin build
